_doc: Earnings-claims phrase list (COMPLIANCE_PLAN A3). 'banned' fails test_compliance_phrases.py when found in a rendered page, an email template or an agent prompt (case-insensitive, word boundaries). 'review' only warns. 'allowed_contexts' are disclaimer phrases removed before matching, so 'not a guarantee' does not trip 'guarantee'. /legal/* pages are excluded: they are counsel's text and are not rewritten here.
